decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-49 MODIFY capturing the reusable-background and translatable-text strategy, so no addition or edit is required.
Message 46 had already established the same tutorial-image strategy for this requirement; message 49 confirms that existing state without changing it.
Changing how localized tutorial text and backgrounds are packaged does not alter the requirement to localize the full Android application.
The reusable tutorial-background strategy does not change the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The tutorial asset strategy does not change Android framework compatibility, deprecated API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The asset-rendering strategy supports localization implementation but does not change the established scope or scale of full-app iOS localization.
The localized-image optimization decision has no effect on the policy to remove unused Android permissions.
The tutorial asset strategy does not change iOS framework modernization, deprecated API replacement, or maintainability requirements.
The reusable-background decision does not affect the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial asset strategy does not affect iOS signing certificates or submission signing configuration.
